in_sanskrit.name: Ransh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector, Ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ransh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ransh is a powerful and protective name derived from Sanskrit and Hindi roots. This name signifies strength, courage, and determination. It is a name for a leader, a protector, and a ruler. It is a name for someone who will face challenges head-on and come out on top.
